en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,
‘When the snatching (of the soul) is difficult upon him, place him in his prayer-mat which he was prayin Salaat in, or on it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If dying becomes difficult for a person, you should place him in the place where he would perform his prayer.’”
